actions.detail: Preflight and WorkPreflight froze schema -> immutability -> generation CAS -> audit -> race tests under a local dependency projection.
Added isolated Behavior revision, certification, release, deployment, and history tables; database immutability/qualification/audit triggers; authorized repositories; and generation CAS.
Eight real PostgreSQL contract and Harness 11 tests passed on the first run with CT-012/013, one CAS winner, immutable old release, authorization denial, and unqualified fail-closed coverage.
Added exact P03-004 mode adapters without repeating the known placeholder failure or modifying Catalog bytes.
The first full-regression invocation was terminated by the orchestration layer's one-second timeout before a test result existed; no product assertion failed and no production state was touched.

After correcting only the invocation timeout to a bounded 60 seconds, the complete Agent CI suite passed: 160 unit/integration tests, 12 contract tests, and all format, lint, type, secret, clock, license, and dependency audit checks.

BLK-P03-004-ORCHESTRATION-TIMEOUT records the second orchestration timeout caused by reusing a one-second tool budget. The durable correction is to use at least 60 seconds for every gate collection containing PostgreSQL tests; no product assertion had run to failure.
